text:
Priya S.: Heads up 0% urgent: Senior IC in EMEA got an external offer with relocation to UK. Manager asked if we can do an out-of-cycle promotion + comp match to retain. Need clear steps for internationals (currency, tax, equity cliff implications).

Dylan K.: manager here. Timeline: candidate responding tomorrow. Can we do title bump + salary increase same week? Also, they got a sign-on equity ask and want vesting start date aligned with hire date.

Ruth H.: short: we can do comp matches and sign-on grants out of cycle but promotions still need promotion packet & calibration. For international moves we must coordinate with Global Mobility and Payroll for tax withholding and gross-to-net calculations.

Priya S.: what forms do we use for EMEA comp changes vs US? Any different approvals?

Ruth H.: process bullets: 
- For comp-only retention (no level): submit CompChange form and mark "international" + attach offer. Comp team evaluates and sets salary in local currency. Approvals: manager + comp lead. Target SLA 48h.
- For promotion + comp: submit Promotion packet (evidence, org impact, new responsibilities) -> calibration required. If timing is tight, managers can request an expedited calibration review with People Ops lead sign-off; provide strong evidence.
- Equity/sign-on: Compensation will prepare grant memo; local legal may need to review for country-specific equity rules. Executive approval required for sign-on > band thresholds.

Dylan K.: how do we show salary in UK GBP if their current comp is EUR? Any conversion rules?

comp-admin-bot: Currency conversion practice: use spot FX rate from payroll vendor on the date of comp change submission. Document rate in CompChange record. Use local market band for role to determine target.

Priya S.: payroll/benefits: relocating employee will change benefits eligibility and tax status. Who triggers benefits enrollment change?

payroll-bot: Mobility flow: once offer accepted and relocation flagged on the CompChange/Relocation form, Global Mobility opens relocation packet. Payroll will update tax codes and benefits eligibility. Payroll cutoff: changes for relocation must be submitted at least 7 business days before payroll run to ensure correct gross-up calculations. See https://intranet/payroll/intl-relocation

Ruth H.: tax gross-ups for sign-on or relocation allowances require finance approval. Also note that effective date semantics differ: for promotions we prefer start-of-next-month; for urgent retention comp we can set immediate effective date but will require retro paperwork if past payroll cutoff.

Dylan K.: equity cliff question: candidate asked to backdate vesting start to when they joined the company originally (they were contractor before). Can we do that as part of counteroffer?

Ruth H.: we can grant an adjusted tranche but backdating vesting start is sensitive. Legal and Equity Ops need to approve, especially for contractor-to-employee transitions. Provide contractor invoice history and manager rationale. Expect 30 business day review.

Priya S.: anything special for calibration docs when promotion crosses bands or countries?

Ruth H.: yes 0 items: 1) include comparator roles in the local region, 2) list scope delta with specific customer/outcome examples, 3) include manager sign-off and Org chart snippet. If cross-country, include note on cost-of-living/market adjustment justification.

Dylan K.: timeline recap for me so I can tell the candidate: if we do comp-only retention: 48h review + effective next payroll (assuming cutoff met). If we want promotion + equity, might be 1-2 weeks. Correct?

Priya S.: yes. Also add: if you want an expedited promotion review, ping People Ops lead and attach Promotion packet and manager attestations. We do ad-hoc approvals for high-risk retention but still require audit trail.

Ruth H.: action items: 1) manager to submit CompChange (international retention) + attach offer and relocation flag, 2) comp team to route to Global Mobility & Equity Ops as needed, 3) payroll to confirm cutoff and FX rate, 4) manager to prepare Promotion packet if they want level change.

Dylan K.: I'll submit CompChange now and ping Priya. Thanks.

Priya S.: thanks everyone. Filing note: keep candidate confidentiality; mark thread private. Closing after comp submission.
